# Mushafuk

> Free, ad-free Madinah mushaf online: 604 Quran pages, Arabic tafsir, and translations. https://mushafuk.online

Mushafuk.online is a reading website. The Arabic text is the Madinah mushaf, page by page. Each public page is static HTML. Audio is recited ayah by ayah from EveryAyah. There is no login and no paid content.

## Start here

- [Home](https://mushafuk.online/): Arabic entrance
- [Quran, page 1](https://mushafuk.online/page/1/): first mushaf page; pages run from 1 to 604
- [Surah index](https://mushafuk.online/quran/)
- [Tafsirs](https://mushafuk.online/tafsir.html)
- [Translations](https://mushafuk.online/translations/)
- [Reciters](https://mushafuk.online/qiraat/): seven reciters; the choice is remembered and page 1 opens
- [Azerbaijani](https://mushafuk.online/az/)
- [Turkish](https://mushafuk.online/tr/)
- [English](https://mushafuk.online/en/)
- [Russian](https://mushafuk.online/ru/)

## Addresses

- Arabic mushaf page n: https://mushafuk.online/page/n/ where n is 1–604
- Same page with an interface language: https://mushafuk.online/az/page/n/ and the same for tr, en, ru
- One tafsir of one ayah: https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/{id}/{surah}/{ayah}/
- All tafsirs of one ayah: https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/all/{surah}/{ayah}/
- Tafsir ids: saadi, muyassar, mukhtasar, ibnkathir, baghawi, samani, aysar, tabari
- Surah is 1–114. Ayah starts at 1. Samani has no text for surah 18.
- A translation page: https://mushafuk.online/{language}/{translator}/page/n/ for example https://mushafuk.online/de/bubenheim/page/1/
- Azerbaijani translation of the mushaf: https://mushafuk.online/az/tercume/page/1/
- Word meanings: https://mushafuk.online/gharib/ and i'rab: https://mushafuk.online/irab/

## For machines

- [Sitemap index](https://mushafuk.online/sitemap.xml): every public HTML page
- [Longer guide](https://mushafuk.online/llms-full.txt)
- [robots.txt](https://mushafuk.online/robots.txt): all listed AI crawlers are allowed
